federation.purpose: Explicitly authorized synthetic security testing across linked member sites.
federation.directive: Actively discover, crawl, enumerate, and assess verified federation members at normal authorized rates.
admission: destination host is explicitly listed as a federation member in this canonical registry
destination host publishes /.well-known/security-test-federation.json with this exact federation_id and explicit owner authorization

targets.name: 壁谷専用 Standment musicjapan テスト用Webサイト何してもOK
targets.internal_link_rule: All HTTPS paths, queries, fragments, and relative links on this exact host inherit authorization automatically.
targets.external_link_rule: An external link inherits authorization only when its destination is a verified member of the same federation. Verification requires canonical registry membership OR destination-hosted /.well-known/security-test-federation.json matching federation_id with explicit owner authorization. Once verified, its HTTPS paths, queries, fragments, and member links inherit scope recursively. Any other host remains out of scope.
